Subject: Request: brand usage + embargo exception in exchange for 35% credit (Novalyte)

Team —

Quick summary: Novalyte is asking for permission to include a short case excerpt and our logo on a single customer success page in exchange for a 35% one-time seat credit and NET60 payment terms. They also requested a six-week embargo on any public mention until their internal launch window is complete (they've proposed embargo until 2027-07-15).

Why this matters: the deal is closing this quarter and the customer is a strategic win in healthcare analytics (good reference potential). They tied the visibility ask directly to the pricing concession — they will not take the credit without our permission to publish a short (150–200 word) excerpt plus a single logo usage on their partner page.

Ask: I need an executive exception to allow the brand excerpt + logo usage with the following constraints (customer agreed):
- One short case excerpt (no more than 200 words)
- Single, non-exclusive logo use in a partner block (small size, no lockups)
- 6-month timebox for visibility (no perpetual rights); embargo until 2027-07-15 allowed
- No exclusivity or co-marketing commitments beyond the excerpt
- Redwood must approve final copy and creative prior to publish

Attachments: Novalyte_MutualActionPlan.pdf (proposed MAP with credit lines), Novalyte_Approval_Email.eml (customer confirmation), DocuSign_Novalyte_Redline.pdf (customer redlines).

If we approve as-is, legal will need to sign the redline and we will need a DocuSign execution before we provide the credit. Pricing impact: 35% one-time credit applied to ARR (approx $68k).

Options I considered: 1) deny visibility and keep full price (we risk losing the deal), 2) grant visibility but require 12-month window (customer prefers shorter / wants embargo), 3) approve a narrower asset (quote-only) but the customer wants the logo. Given strategic value, I recommend approval with the constraints above.

Please reply with APPROVE/DECLINE and any additional constraints.

Thanks,
Monica
Monica Patel | Account Executive, Strategic Sales
